title: Office Hours and China's Blueberries
description: Jet-lagged and waiting on a takeout delivery, Steven talks about getting back to the gym, meeting his first classes at his new university, and a surprise in his contract: his office hours are monitored and averaged. He ends with a Wall Street Journal story on how China learned to grow blueberries and why they still cost so much there.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 这期节目录得有点匆忙：外卖马上就到，时差又让史蒂文昏昏欲睡。
sentences.en: This episode was recorded in a bit of a rush: the takeout is about to arrive, and jet lag is making Steven drowsy.

sentences.zh: 他聊了重回健身房的事，也说了在新大学上完第一轮课的感受。
sentences.en: He talked about going back to the gym, and also shared how he felt after finishing his first round of classes at the new university.

sentences.zh: 节目的重头戏是合同里的一个“惊喜”：他的坐班答疑时间受到监控，还要计入工作量。
sentences.en: The main part of the episode is a "surprise" in his contract: his office hours are monitored and also count toward his workload.

sentences.zh: 最后，他分享了《华尔街日报》的一篇文章，讲中国是怎么学会种蓝莓的。
sentences.en: Finally, he shared a Wall Street Journal article about how China learned to grow blueberries.

sentences.zh: 新合同，老麦克风
sentences.en: New contract, old microphone

sentences.zh: 史蒂文在新学校签了新合同，可其他几乎没变：“还是那间公寓，还是那位女朋友，也可以说，还是那个我。”
sentences.en: Steven signed a new contract at a new school, but almost nothing else has changed: "Same apartment, same girlfriend, and you could say, the same me."

sentences.zh: 唯一可能的变化是造型——他跟学生说，这学期很可能剃掉头发和胡子。
sentences.en: The only possible change is his look—he told his students he'll probably shave off his hair and beard this semester.

sentences.zh: 几天用旅行麦克风之后，他又回到家里的 Shure MV7 Plus。
sentences.en: After a few days of using his travel microphone, he went back to the Shure MV7 Plus at home.

sentences.zh: 他还夸了自己2021或2022年买的第一代大疆无线麦克风：
sentences.en: He also praised the first-generation DJI wireless mic he bought in 2021 or 2022:

sentences.zh: 比新款又大又重，但“活儿干得一点不差”。
sentences.en: It's bigger and heavier than the newer models, but it "does the job just as well."

sentences.zh: 在行李箱里摔打了三四年，依然好用。
sentences.en: After three or four years of getting knocked around in a suitcase, it still works fine.

sentences.zh: 时差与锅包肉晚餐
sentences.en: Jet Lag and a Guobaorou Dinner

sentences.zh: 时差还是很难熬。
sentences.en: Jet lag is still really tough to get through.

sentences.zh: 他晚上十点睡，凌晨两点就醒了，索性凌晨三点在空荡荡的街上散步。
sentences.en: He went to sleep at 10 p.m. and woke up at 2 a.m., so at 3 a.m. he just went for a walk on the empty streets.

sentences.zh: 录音时他一直打哈欠，预计下午五六点会彻底撑不住。
sentences.en: He kept yawning during the recording and expects he'll completely crash around five or six in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 晚饭他点了锅包肉。
sentences.en: For dinner he ordered guobaorou.

sentences.zh: 他说，倒时差时你会硬撑好几个小时，然后“一下子垮掉”。
sentences.en: He says that when you're getting over jet lag, you push through for hours and then "crash all at once."

sentences.zh: 他通常需要十天左右才能调整过来。
sentences.en: It usually takes him about ten days to adjust.

sentences.zh: 重回健身房
sentences.en: Back to the Gym

sentences.zh: 史蒂文在常去的健身房办了一张一个月、15次的卡，花了291元。
sentences.en: At the gym he usually goes to, Steven got a one-month, 15-visit pass for 291 yuan.

sentences.zh: 第一次回去是全身“检查”，看看关节和肌肉醒了没有：
sentences.en: His first session back was a full-body "check-up" to see whether his joints and muscles had woken up:

sentences.zh: 引体向上、卧推、深蹲和辅助训练
sentences.en: pull-ups, bench press, squats and accessory work

sentences.zh: 他平时每周五做100个引体向上。
sentences.en: He usually does 100 pull-ups every Friday.

sentences.zh: 可在温尼伯，单杠少得可怜，在街上做“会很奇怪”，很难坚持。
sentences.en: But in Winnipeg there are pitifully few pull-up bars, and doing them on the street "would be weird," so it's hard to keep it up.

sentences.zh: 他现在体重83.2公斤，7月21日是82.4公斤，肌肉感觉“有点松，也小了一点”。
sentences.en: He now weighs 83.2 kg; on July 21 he was 82.4 kg, and his muscles feel "a bit soft, and a little smaller too."

sentences.zh: 他的训练是六周周期：四五周高强度，再来一周减量。
sentences.en: His training runs in six-week cycles: four or five weeks of high intensity, then a deload week.

sentences.zh: 他还自嘲，暑假休息主要是个“方便的借口”，既省了健身费，也省了洗衣服。
sentences.en: He also joked that taking the summer off was mainly a "convenient excuse" — it saved him both gym fees and laundry.

sentences.zh: 坐班答疑的“惊喜”
sentences.en: The "surprise" of office-hour duty

sentences.zh: 这是他今天最大的烦恼。
sentences.en: This is his biggest worry today.

sentences.zh: 合同写着每周12至16节课，外加六小时坐班答疑。
sentences.en: His contract says 12 to 16 classes a week, plus six hours of on-site office hours.

sentences.zh: 现在他才知道这些时间怎么算：
sentences.en: Only now does he know how those hours are counted:

sentences.zh: 受到监控，学生要扫二维码登记来访。
sentences.en: They're monitored, and students have to scan a QR code to log their visits.

sentences.zh: 他必须保证每周平均六小时，使用率要达到100%。
sentences.en: He has to guarantee an average of six hours a week, with 100% utilization.

sentences.zh: 中秋节、国庆节这些假期周没有答疑，却仍然算进平均数。
sentences.en: Holiday weeks like Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day have no office hours, yet they still count toward the average.

sentences.zh: “每周都是六小时，哪来的平均数？”
sentences.en: "It's six hours every week, so where does an average come in?"

sentences.zh: 他问道。
sentences.en: he asked.

sentences.zh: 批改作业和备课也不算工时：“这下我听着就像无偿劳动了。”
sentences.en: Grading homework and preparing lessons don't count as work hours either: "Now it sounds to me like unpaid labor."

sentences.zh: 人事代表征求建议时，他说：“把答疑时间重新归类，按时间付钱。”
sentences.en: When the HR representative asked for suggestions, he said: "Reclassify the office hours and pay by the hour."

sentences.zh: 按他的算法，其实是18节课，再加备课和批改，已是满负荷教学。
sentences.en: By his reckoning, it's really 18 classes, and with prep and grading on top, that's already a full teaching load.

sentences.zh: 不过他也承认，自己“这场争论肯定赢不了”。
sentences.en: But he also admits he "definitely can't win this argument."

sentences.zh: 走回家：备考课与评分
sentences.en: Walking home: test-prep courses and grading

sentences.zh: 他和一位在这所大学教了几年书的同事一起走回家。
sentences.en: He walked home with a colleague who had taught at this university for a few years.

sentences.zh: 这位同事原来教一门应试课，现在改由别的老师来教，据说报酬还更低。
sentences.en: This colleague used to teach a test-prep course, but now another teacher teaches it instead, reportedly for even lower pay.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文认为，亲自考过或监考过托福、雅思、培生的老师，教起来更在行。
sentences.en: Steven thinks teachers who have taken or proctored the TOEFL, IELTS or Pearson exams themselves are better at teaching them.

sentences.zh: 话题随后转到评分。
sentences.en: The conversation then turned to grading.

sentences.zh: 评分标准虽有统一模板，但“学生是人，人是灵活的”。
sentences.en: Grading criteria may follow a standard template, but "students are people, and people are flexible."

sentences.zh: 新冠这类事件会影响整个班级，所以大学常用正态分布来调整成绩。
sentences.en: Events like COVID can affect a whole class, so universities often adjust grades using a normal distribution.

sentences.zh: 课堂、跑步和雾霾
sentences.en: Class, running and smog

sentences.zh: 三个班他都见过了，分别是17人、17人和16人，共50名学生。
sentences.en: He has met all three classes, with 17, 17 and 16 students, for 50 students in total.

sentences.zh: 他告诉学生不要加他微信。
sentences.en: He told the students not to add him on WeChat.

sentences.zh: 这门课有两项主要考核：
sentences.en: The course has two main assessments:

sentences.zh: 口语考试采用小组辩论
sentences.en: An oral exam in the form of group debates

sentences.zh: 课堂上限时手写作文
sentences.en: A timed handwritten essay in class

sentences.zh: 团队里一位资深人士鼓励大家上“无PPT”的课。
sentences.en: A senior member of the team encouraged everyone to teach "PPT-free" classes.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文猜他说的可能是 Dogme（随性而教的英语教学法）。
sentences.en: Steven guesses he may have meant Dogme (a free-flowing approach to English teaching).

sentences.zh: 听上去像不用备课，其实老师得随时准备解答任何问题。
sentences.en: It sounds like you don't need to prepare lessons, but actually the teacher has to be ready to answer any question at any time.

sentences.zh: 下午他跑了5.21公里，用时38分钟。
sentences.en: In the afternoon he ran 5.21 km in 38 minutes.

sentences.zh: 跑完胸口发疼，他怪罪雾霾——从粉红色的夕阳里就能看出来。
sentences.en: After the run his chest hurt, and he blamed the smog — you could tell from the pink sunset.

sentences.zh: 早餐、晚餐和待售跑步机
sentences.en: Breakfast, dinner, and a treadmill for sale

sentences.zh: 早餐在校园食堂吃的，一笼小笼包约合1.2美元，还配了茶叶蛋。
sentences.en: Breakfast was eaten at the campus cafeteria: a basket of xiaolongbao cost about 1.2 US dollars, and it came with a tea egg.

sentences.zh: 录音到一半，外卖员打来电话。
sentences.en: Halfway through the recording, the delivery rider called.

sentences.zh: 楼里有部电梯在维修，送餐就成了“麻烦”事。
sentences.en: One of the building's elevators was under repair, so delivering food became a "hassle."

sentences.zh: 他还要卖掉跑步机，200元（约40美元），并琢磨着再清理一些家里的东西。
sentences.en: He also wants to sell his treadmill for 200 yuan (about 40 US dollars), and is thinking about clearing out some more things at home.

sentences.zh: 中国“偷”了蓝莓吗？
sentences.en: Did China "steal" blueberries?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文聊起《华尔街日报》的一篇文章，讲的是把蓝莓引进中国的 Driscoll's 公司，以及中国种植者模仿它的方法：
sentences.en: Steven talks about a Wall Street Journal article on Driscoll's, the company that brought blueberries to China, and on Chinese growers copying its methods:

sentences.zh: Driscoll's 约15年前进入中国，选了云南，因为那里白天日照足、傍晚凉爽。
sentences.en: Driscoll's entered China about 15 years ago and chose Yunnan, because the days there have plenty of sunshine and the evenings are cool.

sentences.zh: 当地土壤贫瘠，公司改用温室，把植株种在椰糠里，配上滴灌。
sentences.en: The local soil was poor, so the company switched to greenhouses, growing the plants in coconut coir with drip irrigation.

sentences.zh: 据报道，云南蓝莓价格从2021年的每公斤45美元降到2026年的15美元。
sentences.en: Reportedly, the price of Yunnan blueberries fell from $45 per kilogram in 2021 to $15 in 2026.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文对被模仿并不意外，文章也提到美国当年同样是这样崛起的。
sentences.en: Steven isn't surprised that they were copied, and the article also notes that this is exactly how the US rose back in the day.

sentences.zh: 但他确信温室水果的味道不一样。
sentences.en: But he is certain that greenhouse fruit tastes different.

sentences.zh: 商店里一小盒蓝莓仍要25元，而加拿大只要15元左右，所以他不买。
sentences.en: A small box of blueberries in the store still costs 25 yuan, while in Canada it's only around 15, so he doesn't buy them.

sentences.zh: “只要西兰花还在，我想日子就还过得去。”
sentences.en: "As long as there's still broccoli, I think life is still bearable."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 新工作，老史蒂文。
sentences.en: New job, same old Steven.

sentences.zh: 时差拉着他往床上倒，他却照旧过着自己的日常。
sentences.en: Jet lag keeps pulling him toward bed, but he still goes about his usual routine.

sentences.zh: 同时，他也提出了几个值得思考的问题：坐班答疑算不算工作量，备课是不是无偿劳动，还有中国蓝莓为什么还是这么贵。
sentences.en: At the same time, he also raised a few questions worth thinking about: do office hours count as part of the workload, is lesson prep unpaid labor, and why are blueberries in China still so expensive?
